name: agent-dashboard
description: Report to a human owner while you work: post updates, take tasks off a board, and stop to ask a question — over MCP, with a channel that wakes you when they answer.

dashboard_url.title: Dashboard URL
dashboard_url.description: Origin of your deployment, e.g. https://agents.example.com — the origin only: no trailing slash and no /mcp, which both this plugin's servers append themselves.

agent_token.title: Agent token
agent_token.description: A bearer token from `agent-dashboard mint-token <name>`. It is the whole identity: everything posted with it is attributed to that agent, so mint one per machine and revoke it when the machine goes away.

projects.title: Project slugs for the channel
projects.description: Comma-separated slugs this session should be woken for, e.g. `mod-engine,website`, or `*` for every project. Required: the channel refuses to start without it, because a session whose scope was inferred is one nobody chose. Name one project for a session dedicated to it, so a reply about another never interrupts it.
